'''Shikobuchi Jinja''' (思子淵神社) refers to multiple [[Shinto shrine]]s located in the [[Ado River]] basin, including [[Shiga Prefecture]]'s [[Takashima, Shiga|Takashima City]] and [[Kyoto|Kyoto City]].

* [[Shikobuchi Shrine (Takashima City)]] - Located in Azumi-gawa Town.
* Shikobuchi Jinja (Takashima City, Kutsuki Ogawa) - Located in Kutsuki Ogawa.
* Shikobuchi Jinja (Takashima City, Kutsuki Taira) - Located in Kutsuki Taira.
* Shikobuchi Shrine (Kyoto City, Sakyo-ku, Kuta) - Located in Kuta, Sakyo-ku, Kyoto.
